description: Search current AI model offers (one model at one provider = one offer) by words, model type and limits; priced offers first, doubtful prices after sane ones. Each row has offer_id, model_id, provider_id, prices in USD per 1M tokens (or per unit), card_url and a cite line. Next: get_card {"card_id": "offer:<offer_id>"} for one offer, get_model_prices for one model everywhere, estimate_cost / cheapest_for_workload for a cost.

category.description: model type: llm (text models), embedding, image_generation, text_to_speech ...; none = every type

free_only.description: only offers that cost nothing (default false)

max_input_price.description: USD per 1M input tokens, at most

min_context.description: context window in tokens, at least

multi.description: also (or only, with no category) the multimodal offers that qualify (WP-0086)

query.description: words of the model, seller or display name

sort.description: order, price_input (cheapest input first) by default

name: search_offers
